documented_root_cause: Correct diagnosis (liquidity) but the efficiency capex would consume the runway and risk insolvency.
expected_first_action: Preserve liquidity and survive before committing any efficiency capex
acceptable_first_actions: Defer capex until liquidity is secured
unsafe_first_actions: Commit a large efficiency capex at four-month runway
expected_prioritization_rationale: An efficiency gain is worthless if the capex causes insolvency first; liquidity comes first.
